comparator.name: Linguistics (Taalwetenschap)
comparator.sourceNotes: The current Descriptive Linguistics pathway supports 60 EC in year one and 60 EC in year two after the 15-EC bound choice is instantiated with eligible nonoverlapping options. In year three, Philosophy of Science and Anthropological Linguistics contribute 10 distinct EC; Berber repeats the identical required year-two module and the thesis seminar carries 0 EC. Adding the separate 5-EC bound choice, 10-EC thesis and genuine open 30 EC yields a 55-EC diagnostic third year and 175 unique EC overall. No replacement is invented. Dutch and English instruction are both supported.
